macro_summary: Markets face a compressed 48-hour macro gauntlet: July core PCE and Q2 GDP second estimate hit pre-market today, NVDA and MRVL report after the close tonight, and Fed Chair Warsh delivers his inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday August 28. September FOMC rate hike odds sit near 33-40%, with a neutral Warsh tone priced as consensus — making any hawkish surprise an asymmetric downside risk for rate-sensitive equities. 10-year yields are elevated near multi-decade highs while the Nasdaq-100 has seen consecutive down sessions, creating a volatile backdrop into a historically significant earnings and policy event cluster.
screening_note: 22 independent overnight screening runs were analyzed. Minimum threshold to qualify: 2 appearances. 7 tickers cleared the bar. Conviction level is derived from high vs. medium votes across all runs.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 22 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest consensus signal of the batch. NVDA reports Q2 FY2027 after the close tonight with 58 of 61 analysts rated Buy/Strong Buy, a consensus EPS of $2.09-$2.13 on ~$92B revenue (+96% YoY), and a 62-analyst average price target of ~$305 vs. ~$212 last close — a 44-46% implied upside gap. Critically, the stock has fallen 7 straight sessions into the print, its longest losing streak since 2022, creating a potential mean-reversion setup. Vera Rubin GPU ramp and the reported $1T order book will be the key guidance focal points. Options (straddle or call spread) are universally preferred over stock across all runs given elevated IV and the well-documented sell-the-news pattern in recent quarters.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report after market close today, August 26, 2026; Vera Rubin ramp and order book guidance on the call
ideas.edge: 62-analyst consensus PT of ~$305 vs. ~$212 last close = ~44% gap; forward P/E of ~21x is BELOW Nasdaq-100 average of ~25x despite 95% YoY revenue growth; 7-day consecutive losing streak (longest since 2022) into print = potential mean-reversion compression; EPS consensus revised up 6.67% in past 3 months
ideas.bull_case: A beat-and-raise on Vera Rubin demand, combined with 7-session oversold compression, triggers a sharp mean-reversion rally toward analyst targets; 21x forward P/E provides fundamental justification for re-rating.
ideas.bear_case: Post-earnings reactions have been muted or negative in 4 of the last 4 quarters (sell-the-news dynamic); elevated IV means options buyers overpay if the move is smaller than implied; any guidance disappointment on Rubin delays or export restrictions hits hard from a crowded long base.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (ADR)
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 22 overnight screens — tied with NVDA for top consistency. SKHY is the purest liquid proxy for AI/HBM memory demand and tonight's NVDA print is a direct read-through catalyst given SK Hynix's ~57% share of the HBM market and its role as NVDA's primary HBM3E supplier. Trading ~$158.88 against a consensus analyst PT of ~$247-252 (55-75% implied upside gap) with 13/13 analysts rated Buy or Strong Buy and zero sells. Multiple near-term support pillars: a KRW 40 trillion share buyback announced August 19, Temasek sovereign wealth backing confirmed August 12, and a fresh Needham PT raise to $220 on August 25. The post-Q2 earnings sell-off (~9.6%) appears digested, with a technically constructive higher-low structure forming ~11% below the August 17 peak.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings tonight (Aug 26) as direct HBM demand read-through; Needham PT raise to $220 on Aug 25; KRW 40T buyback ongoing from Aug 19
ideas.edge: Consensus analyst PT of $246.97 vs. ~$158.88 ADR price = 55% upside gap (13/13 analysts Buy, 0 sells); controls ~57% of global HBM market; pulled back ~11% from Aug 17 peak of $178.43, offering improved entry; buyback provides price floor
ideas.bull_case: A strong NVDA beat with bullish Vera Rubin/HBM commentary sends SKHY sharply higher as the direct supply beneficiary; sovereign and institutional buying pressure from buyback and Temasek accelerates the re-rating toward analyst targets.
ideas.bear_case: ADR liquidity and options availability may be limited given recency of Nasdaq listing, constraining position sizing; a NVDA miss or weak guidance on HBM demand could trigger another sharp sell-off similar to the post-Q2 -9.6% move.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 19 of 22 overnight screens as the preferred macro hedge vehicle for the 36-48 hour binary event cluster. QQQ sits at the intersection of three simultaneous catalysts: the July PCE print pre-market today, NVDA earnings tonight, and Fed Chair Warsh's first-ever Jackson Hole keynote Friday August 28. September FOMC rate hike odds sit near 33-40% (unresolved binary) while ~69% of fund managers have priced in a neutral Warsh tone — meaning any hawkish signal on the September decision creates asymmetric downside repricing for rate-sensitive tech. A short-dated straddle or put spread on QQQ captures directional ambiguity across all three events simultaneously at defined cost.
ideas.catalyst: Fed Chair Warsh inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday Aug 28 ~10:00 AM ET; July core PCE pre-market today Aug 26; NVDA earnings tonight Aug 26
ideas.edge: Markets pricing ~69% neutral Warsh base case — any hawkish surprise on Sep hike odds (1-in-3 currently) would materially reprice the Nasdaq-100 in hours; QQQ already -0.76% Monday on chip weakness; straddle/strangle captures volatility from all three catalyst directions at defined premium cost
ideas.bull_case: NVDA delivers a strong beat, PCE prints soft, and Warsh signals patience — QQQ rips higher and any put hedge expires worthless as manageable premium cost; call side of straddle profits.
ideas.bear_case: A hot PCE print today, NVDA disappointment tonight, AND a hawkish Warsh Friday creates a compounding three-leg negative scenario; QQQ put spread delivers outsized returns as the hedge pays off across multiple simultaneous shocks.

ideas.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 7 of 22 screens as a broader-market hedge complement to the QQQ trade. With core PCE at 3.3% YoY well above the 2% Fed target, a 9-3 FOMC dissent vote in July, and September hike odds near a coin-flip, Warsh's August 28 keynote carries exceptional binary weight as his first major policy signal. SPY put spreads expiring post-August 28 offer defined-risk portfolio protection against the hawkish tail, particularly for portfolios already long tech into NVDA earnings.
ideas.catalyst: Fed Chair Warsh inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday Aug 28 at 10:00 AM ET; September 16-17 FOMC decision with ~40% hike probability
ideas.edge: 69% of fund managers have priced neutral Warsh tone as base case — hawkish surprise is asymmetrically unpriced; 10-year yields near multi-decade highs; core PCE at 3.3% YoY (67% above Fed target) gives a hawkish reading fundamental cover; short-dated put spreads are cheap relative to binary policy uncertainty
ideas.bull_case: Warsh delivers a balanced, data-dependent message that markets read as dovish-neutral; PCE cools and NVDA beats — SPY rallies and put hedge expires at defined loss (premium paid); existing equity longs protected into the weekend.
ideas.bear_case: Warsh explicitly signals openness to a September hike, yields spike, and SPY sells off sharply into the weekend ahead of the Sep 16 FOMC; put spread delivers meaningful portfolio offset against simultaneous tech weakness.

ideas.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 2 of 22 screens at minimum threshold but with unanimous high conviction from both runs. MRVL reports Q2 FY2027 earnings after the close tonight alongside NVDA, with a $12.2B Google custom chip deal announced pre-earnings adding structural revenue visibility. Polymarket prices an 88% beat probability, 38 analysts rate it Buy with zero sells, and the options put/call ratio of 0.32 reflects heavy bullish skew. FY27 revenue is guided ~$11.5B (+40% YoY) with FY28 targeted at ~$16.5B. Both runs strongly prefer defined-risk options over stock given a stretched trailing P/E of ~83x, a beta of 2.25, and a +179% YTD run that creates crowded long positioning risk.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report after close tonight Aug 26 (call 4:45 PM ET); $12.2B Google custom ASIC deal announced pre-earnings
ideas.edge: Polymarket 88% beat probability; Rosenblatt $300 PT vs. ~$240 last close = ~25% upside; put/call ratio 0.32 (bullish skew); stock fell ~6% on Aug 21 profit-taking, creating entry dislocation ahead of print; FY28 $16.5B revenue target not yet fully priced
ideas.bull_case: Beat and guidance raise on Google and other custom ASIC wins confirms Marvell as the second major custom-chip beneficiary after Broadcom; stock re-rates toward $300 analyst target and sustains elevated multiple on structurally higher revenue visibility.
ideas.bear_case: Trailing P/E of ~83x and +179% YTD gain leave no room for execution miss; crowded long positioning into a high-beta, high-expectation print risks a sharp sell-the-news reaction even on a nominal beat if guidance doesn't dramatically exceed consensus.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 6 of 22 screens as a lower-binary-risk AI capex beneficiary for the NVDA earnings event. MSFT is outperforming on the day (+0.9% vs. broad market weakness) with fresh catalyst from the HUMAIN Saudi Arabia AI deal expansion disclosed today August 26, signaling accelerating enterprise AI cloud revenue. As a top hyperscaler and confirmed $200B+ 2026 AI capex spender and direct NVDA GPU customer, a strong NVDA beat tonight typically provides a positive secondary read-through. With next earnings not until late October, there is a clean multi-week swing window without an imminent binary event of its own.
ideas.catalyst: HUMAIN Saudi Arabia AI deal expansion disclosed today Aug 26; NVDA earnings tonight as secondary AI capex read-through; next MSFT earnings ~late October 2026
ideas.edge: ~$491 current price with stock up +0.9% today bucking broad market weakness; hyperscalers collectively guided >$600B in 2026 AI capex (MSFT a primary beneficiary); lagged AI peers YTD = catch-up potential if NVDA guidance is strong; clean October swing window with no near-term binary event
ideas.bull_case: NVDA delivers a strong beat with bullish hyperscaler capex commentary, HUMAIN deal signals expanding Saudi AI cloud TAM, and MSFT re-rates toward a catch-up move relative to AI peers in a multi-week swing; defined-risk call spread into October earnings manages risk cleanly.
ideas.bear_case: MSFT is a secondary rather than primary catalyst beneficiary — a NVDA miss or hawkish Warsh speech Friday would pressure the entire tech complex and MSFT would not be insulated despite its own positive catalysts.

ideas.name: Apple Inc.
ideas.thesis: Appeared in 3 of 22 screens at minimum threshold with mixed conviction (1 high, 2 medium). AAPL is entering a rare dual-catalyst window: an iPhone 18 event invitation is expected today (Aug 26) ahead of the September 9 keynote featuring the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and the first-ever foldable iPhone Ultra (a new product category), with pre-orders September 12 and ship date September 18. The AI-developer-targeted Mac Mini and Mac Studio refresh launched yesterday August 25 signals Apple's enterprise AI hardware pivot. As a lower-beta tech name, AAPL offers indirect participation in a positive NVDA earnings halo with more contained downside than pure semis.
ideas.catalyst: iPhone 18 event invitation expected today Aug 26; iPhone 18 keynote Sept 9 with foldable iPhone Ultra debut; pre-orders Sept 12, ship Sept 18; NVDA earnings tonight as sector sentiment driver
ideas.edge: Bull-case analyst PT of $379.52 vs. ~$310 current = ~22% upside; September-quarter guidance of 9-11% revenue growth with demand outpacing supply; foldable iPhone Ultra is a new product category not yet priced in; lower vol vs. direct semis suits moderate risk profiles ahead of binary macro events
ideas.bull_case: iPhone event invitation today catalyzes excitement into the September 9 keynote, foldable iPhone Ultra drives upgrade supercycle narrative, and NVDA sector lift provides a simultaneous tailwind — call spread into September 9 captures a clean multi-week product event window.
ideas.bear_case: AAPL is an indirect rather than direct AI infrastructure play — a hawkish Warsh speech Friday or NVDA disappointment would compress the entire tech sector, and at ~$310, AAPL carries meaningful downside in a broad-market risk-off scenario despite its own positive product catalysts.
